title: Joanne's Home — Sugar Land Exterior | Paint It Forward
metaDescription: A Paint It Forward exterior restoration in Sugar Land, TX: failing fascia and a damaged gate repaired, then a full repaint with Sherwin-Williams coatings.
h1: Joanne's Home — Sugar Land Exterior Restoration
products: Sherwin-Williams primer for bare and repaired wood
narrative: Joanne's home was our very first Paint It Forward exterior project — and it was a special one. The fascia boards were deteriorating and falling off, the wooden gate was damaged, and the whole exterior had clearly seen better days.

Like so many homes in the Houston-area climate, the paint had given up under years of sun and humidity. We started with the parts you can't skip: replacing and repairing the failing fascia, rebuilding the damaged gate, and washing the entire exterior back to a sound surface.

From there it was a full prep-first repaint — spot-priming the repairs and bare wood, re-caulking the joints that move, and laying down a durable Sherwin-Williams coating system built to hold up to Texas weather. The result gave Joanne back a home she could be proud of.
